about: Input for tools/comfy/palette_extract.py: where each material is sampled. Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in image pixels (origin top-left, x1/y1 exclusive); hue in degrees, sat/val in 0-1 (HSV). The concept is the MIRRORED hero front (784x1168, cannon on his right arm, the resolved design); its background is a radial gradient, so the birefnet figure mask (mask) replaces the flat-background test. 'sheet' is the approved turnaround sheet (1168x784): the cape emblem is sampled there, its colour-script chips are the anchors, and the cross-checks measure the same materials on it. tones = CIELAB L* percentiles reported as shadow/base/highlight (emissive: rim/hot/core). Edit a box, re-run the tool, look at reports/stage0_palette_samples.png.
title: VALDRIS
subtitle: The Anvil-Born  -  colour callouts
header_note: Measured from the approved hero front, mirrored so the cannon is on his right arm (references/valdris_concept_front_mirrored.png), and from the approved turnaround sheet. Derived data, not new design.
value_note: Valdris is one DARK block (gunmetal plate, cannon, anvil, beard: L* 10-20) with two lighter accents: the gold trim (MID-LIGHT) and the war-red cape (DARK-MID, a hue, not a value). The EMISSIVE seams and the muzzle sit above everything. At game scale he reads by silhouette + gold + glow, so the toon ramp must lift the plate's lit faces (highlight tone) and keep the seams unlit.

swatches.label: Gunmetal plate
swatches.note: the whole armour shell: dark, cracked, faceted; lit faces lift to the highlight tone

swatches.label: Anvil chest plate
swatches.note: the anvil: same dark iron, flatter and greyer; its flat top face is the lightest plate

swatches.label: Siege-cannon steel
swatches.note: barrel and breech between the gold bands; same family as the plate

swatches.label: Forge-gold trim
swatches.note: plate edges, cannon rings, fist cuffs, braid rings: the mid-light accent that outlines every plate

swatches.label: Glowing seams
swatches.note: cracks between plates, anvil flanks, knees; unlit in the shader, bloom does the rest

swatches.label: Cannon muzzle
swatches.note: the hottest point on him and his aim read; Siege Stance and firing push it to white

swatches.label: War-red cape
swatches.note: the one cloth mass and the one saturated hue; tattered hem, gold emblem on the back

swatches.label: Skin
swatches.note: weathered, scarred scalp and face; tiny at game scale

swatches.label: Braided beard
swatches.note: iron-grey braids; merges into one dark mass above the anvil at game scale

swatches.label: Cape emblem
swatches.note: the gold sigil on the back of the cape (turnaround sheet, back view)

anchors.label: Glowing seams white-hot
anchors.note: a line sample, not a chip: the sheet names no hex for it

pairs: one steel material for armour and cannon
the anvil is the same iron, a touch lighter
one gold for trim and emblem
checks.content_note: the kit colour is his lit gold trim
checks.bg_note: the plate sits on the near-black background by value; gold trim, seams and the outline carry the silhouette
